backbone._comment: Candidate backbone paths per site pair handed to the optimiser: the direct link plus the (candidate_paths - 1) shortest routes over one relaying site (needs a SWITCH there). All traffic of a site pair uses one path. lazy_traffic (on): no per-flow traffic variables; a callback adds the 'pair needs a selected path' and link-capacity constraints as lazy cuts (33 cells: gap 1.4 % after 30 min instead of 9 %). path_link_cut (on): a selected path has a cable on each of its links (static). conservation_cut (off): aggregated flow conservation of the explicit-traffic model; slower in tests.
